subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• As biological systems, coral reefs exhibit remarkably efficient nutrient cycling in nutrient-poor environments.
• A research team led by Maribel Hidalgo wanted to better understand the mechanisms behind these nutrient retention processes.
• Hidalgo's team used controlled aquarium experiments that replicated coral reef ecosystem conditions.
• The researchers measured nitrogen and phosphorus levels at different depths within the reef structure.
• When symbiotic algae were removed from the coral, nutrient retention decreased significantly, indicating their crucial role in the cycling process.
prompt: The student wants to present the primary aim of the research study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The researchers used controlled aquarium experiments that replicated coral reef conditions and measured nitrogen and phosphorus levels at different depths.
choices.B: After measuring nutrient levels at different depths, the researchers found that nutrient retention decreased significantly when symbiotic algae were removed.
choices.C: Hidalgo's team wanted to better understand the mechanisms behind coral reefs' remarkably efficient nutrient retention processes.
choices.D: As studied by Hidalgo's team, coral reefs are biological systems that exhibit remarkably efficient nutrient cycling in nutrient-poor environments.

explanation: Choice C is the best answer. It describes the reason Hidalgo's team wanted to study coral reef ecosystems—that is to say, the study's primary aim.
